details:
Dropbox.com links are supposed to be whitelisted for the Image Downloader, according to the creator docs, but this appears to no longer be the case. This is because the two whitelisted URLs, dl.dropbox.com and dl.dropboxusercontent.com, are no longer used by dropbox.

Publicly sharing a file on dropbox now creates a link in this format: https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/p2wsv4jld4b1z8ky1afm2/VRChat_2025-03-02_18-52-39.884_1920x1080.png?rlkey=i410x0otwyfugh3xgcat2r9eh&st=ga2u8809&dl=1

This link, when loaded, re-directs to a temporary URL active for just a few minutes, starting with [hex string].dl.dropboxusercontent.com. As the Image Downloader neither follows redirects, nor will this subdomain match anything on the whitelist anyways (due to the preceding hex string), the image is not downloaded.

This is frustrating for both:

Players, who can not plug dropbox links into image sharing props, such as ImagePad, despite being told its supposed to be whitelisted.

World Creators who prefer or are required to use dropbox as the platform to upload images for display in-world (i.e. posters) to.

Please either: adjust Image Downloader to once again be able to handle dropbox links, i.e. by whitelisting *.dl.dropboxusercontent.com and allowing the one redirect.

Or remove dropbox from the whitelist entirely and properly communicate to creators that this option is no longer valid.
title: dropbox.com no longer whitelisted properly for Image Downloading
